name: Akira Edgworth
original_name: アキラ エッジワース
source:
Akira is the heiress of the aristocratic Scottish Edgworth family.
She comes to Shironagasu Island to discover the truth about her father, to whom the invitation was actually sent.
Akira tells detective [url=/c95244]Ikeda[/url] to not look into the island's secrets, which would mean that she knows more about them than she is letting on.

[From [url=https://tabinomichi.jp/shironagasu/en/]official website[/url]]
